row: To be real. I want to create a platform where I can create and share.  I am an empty nester in my late 40s and I feel like I'm living the best part of my life.  I feel accomplished as a mother, and wife and now want to be as creative as I can be and have fun doing it.  I want to share my fun thrift trips.  I love to create cute outfits with thrifted clothes, as well as decorate my house using thrifted treasures. I work from home as a massage therapist in what I call the perfect situation. We built the house of our dreams and along with that, I built my very own massage studio and office so that I can see clients at home!
